text_block_list.text:
The autumn Tenno Sho has finally
arrived. Eishin
Flash's parents are in the
crowd, and she asks me
to watch the
race with them.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Эйсин Флэш reflects upon her journey as
the
crowd roars around her. It all started
from her
sense of what is "right," and
now at the end...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She realizes how many experiences and

connections she's formed. She quietly
burns,
excited for the chance to show
the three of us the
truth that she's found
for herself.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
